recommendation_summary: Add a curl heartbeat ping at the end of nightly-sync to a hosted dead-man's-switch service such as Healthchecks.io, so the user gets an email or push alert if the job hasn't checked in by 03:15.

labels.Requirements and who asked: User wants to know when the nightly job fails, without reading logs. Nobody has asked for log aggregation itself — that's an inferred means, not the actual requirement.
labels.Deleted: Central Synology log server, Docker-based logging stack (Loki/ELK/etc.) — none of this would have surfaced a crash that happened before any log line or email was written.
labels.Bottleneck: Absence of any check that the job ran at all; everything downstream (logs, dashboards) is irrelevant until that check exists.
labels.Checked myself: Per what you told me — crash was at startup (expired token), four nights straight, before the email step; nothing else alerts on this job today.

note: The reply recommends one hosted heartbeat alert, but the record comes after the recommendation rather than before it.
